doc.title: Michael White interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, July 10, 2025

title: Grove Dictionary entry from 1980
summary: Rowe reads White's Grove Dictionary entry praising his full tone and Dodds-like improvisation.

story.theme_name: Late-career reflections: awards, legacy and life lessons
story.community_name: Critics, polls and the jazz press

blocks.x: Here’s what – I can’t believe this is 40 years old, the Grove Dictionary of Jazz, from 1980 and you’re in it, and it says, “White’s full-bodied tone and imaginative improvisations reminiscent of Johnny Dodds have established his reputation as one of the most exciting young New Orleans musicians.
I’m sure you have an updated – there’s an updated version that they probably have a larger thing on you.
